notes: Files keep their real names again. Chrome shuts the extension down while a run waits on SiteGiant, and the name it meant to save under went with it — so the file arrived as "download.zip" and the run reported that another extension had overridden it. The name was being dropped here, not taken.
The run now keeps what it needs somewhere that survives being shut down, holds itself awake while a run is in flight, and makes Chrome wait for the name instead of picking its own.
